remediation.issue: The validator documents a --fix option but does not implement it.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the option from documentation or implement an explicit confirmation-gated fix action.

content.user_title: Build consistent brand guidelines and assets
content.value_statement: Brand work can become inconsistent across content, assets, and interfaces. This skill provides structured guidance, validation, and token synchronization to keep brand decisions aligned.
actual_capabilities: Creates brand voice, messaging, and visual identity guidance.
Provides templates for brand guidelines and approval workflows.
Extracts palette colors from a local brand-guidelines file.
Validates local asset names, formats, sizes, and manifest registration.
Updates local design-token files from documented brand colors.
Generates prompt-ready brand context from a local guidelines file.
limitations: Image color extraction requires a separate image-analysis tool or ImageMagick.
Token synchronization expects the documented project file locations.
The skill does not verify trademark ownership or legal compliance.
Generated guidance needs review by brand owners before publication.

use_cases.title: Define a new brand voice
use_cases.description: Create a clear voice framework and messaging guidance for a new product launch.

use_cases.title: Review campaign assets
use_cases.description: Check local asset names, formats, sizes, and registration before campaign delivery.

use_cases.title: Align interface tokens
use_cases.description: Transfer documented brand colors into local design tokens for a product interface.

prompt_templates.title: Create a brand voice
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a concise brand voice guide for [brand]. Include personality, tone, preferred language, and prohibited terms.

prompt_templates.title: Draft brand guidelines
prompt_templates.prompt: Create brand guidelines for [brand] using [audience], [mission], [colors], and [typefaces]. Include visual and messaging standards.

prompt_templates.title: Review brand consistency
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these campaign materials against our brand guidelines. List inconsistencies, explain each issue, and recommend precise corrections.

prompt_templates.title: Update design tokens
prompt_templates.prompt: Update our brand guidelines with these color decisions, then prepare the local design-token synchronization workflow. Use a dry run first.

output_examples.input: Create a voice guide for a reliable payroll service.
output: Avoid: exaggerated claims and unexplained jargon.

output_examples.input: Review an image asset for brand compliance.
output: Filename follows the campaign naming pattern.
PNG format and file size meet the defined limits.
Register the asset in the local manifest before approval.

output_examples.input: Define primary and accent colors for a product interface.
output: Primary color: a clear blue for key actions.
Accent color: a contrasting green for success states.
Document accessible contrast checks before release.

best_practices: Keep one reviewed brand-guidelines file as the source of truth.
Run token synchronization with a dry run before writing project files.
Review generated brand content with the responsible brand owner.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated messaging as legal or trademark advice.
Do not paste suggested shell commands for filenames you do not trust.
Do not overwrite design tokens without reviewing the proposed changes.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It supports brand voice, visual identity, messaging, asset standards, and token workflows.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The package declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it analyze image pixels directly?
faq.answer: No. It prepares color comparison guidance and can use a separate image-analysis tool.

faq.question: Can it update design tokens?
faq.answer: Yes. Its sync script updates local token files from documented brand colors.

faq.question: Does asset validation modify files?
faq.answer: No. The validator reports issues and filename suggestions without renaming assets.

faq.question: Should I trust injected brand context automatically?
faq.answer: Use only reviewed guidelines files because their content is included in prompt-ready output.
